Recursive read-write spin lock with nested read and write locking support.

# Purpose
Defines a small recursive read-write spin lock in `fd_rwlock_recursive_t`. The lock supports nested write locks, nested read locks by the write owner, and normal concurrent read locks, but it does not support read-to-write upgrade. The file provides inline functions to initialize the lock, acquire and release write access with [`fd_rwlock_recursive_wlock`](<#fd_rwlock_recursive_wlock>) and [`fd_rwlock_recursive_wunlock`](<#fd_rwlock_recursive_wunlock>), and acquire and release read access with [`fd_rwlock_recursive_rlock`](<#fd_rwlock_recursive_rlock>) and [`fd_rwlock_recursive_runlock`](<#fd_rwlock_recursive_runlock>). It also includes checks for recursion depth, lock misuse, and invalid unlock order, and it uses thread ID tracking plus atomic operations when threads are enabled.
